The **RL** group of the node palette has 4 nodes: all run.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Environment](../rl/environment.md) | Runs | N copies of an environment to train in. |
| [Policy Head](../rl/policy-head.md) | Runs | Ends the policy layers: the output layer and the action distribution. |
| [PPO](../rl/ppo.md) | Runs | Proximal Policy Optimization: trains the policy and value layers on the environment. |
| [Value Head](../rl/value-head.md) | Runs | Ends the value layers: one output, the expected return. |
